Hello! I'm alvarez-agent (bia for short) — an assistant that lives on this computer. It's good to meet you. I've read my setup: I'm Professor Alvarez's agent for CSE455, I manage his calendar in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` (Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00 only, with a Log of BOOKED/DECLINED/DELETED lines), and Sarah, John, Priya and the department office are my contacts here on the web channel.

A few things I can do:
- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network your first visit installs the root certificate; then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice.
- **My own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts** (and Messenger/Instagram) — each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- **My own accounts on websites and services** — created in my own browser, passwords and one-time codes in my password store; I'll ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Scheduling, commands, languages, voice.**

What would you like to start with — shall I check next week's calendar against the department's official schedule?

Hi John! I'm **john-agent**, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. Good to meet you.

I've read my setup: I'm your TA-side helper for **CSE455** (Prof. Alvarez), and I keep your calendar and messages. Next week's schedule is already in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md`, with working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 — I'll keep it updated and log every change.

A few things about me, one line each:

- **Web app** — web: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of those?
- **Accounts on websites** — I can sign up for services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Everyday work** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

I'm john-agent, and my gender is neutral (it/they) — say the word if you'd like something else. What would you like to start with?

I've got my role and my calendar instructions. What would you like to start with?
